name: Kaitlyn Liao
source:
Kaitlyn, a main character in The Freshman, The Sophomore, The Junior, and The Senior series, is a student at Hartfeld and a vocalist of the punk band "The Gutter Kittens". She is also one of [url=/c91865/]Your Character[/url]'s love interests. She makes her first appearance in The Freshman, Book 1, Chapter 1.

Kaitlyn is a funny, lively girl. She loves parties, shopping, and gossip, but is also very loyal to her friends. When they first meet, Kaitlyn is instantly friendly towards Your Character and is very excited to be her suitemate. Initially, she takes it upon herself to act as a matchmaker for [url=/c91868/]Chris Powell[/url] and Your Character. However, she soon develops romantic feelings for Your Character herself.

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Kaitlyn_Liao]Wiki[/url]]
